name: Kasamatsu (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kasamatsu town emblem in green: an outlined ring crossed by a winged device with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kasamatsu, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1965.

features.role: Kasamatsu town emblem — an outlined ring crossed by a winged device with a stylised character
